description: §4.12.2 (S443) — a `<program auth="required">` inside a `<page>` is nested too (a `<page>` is a per-route container inside the application's one `<program>`, §40.8) and fires E-PROGRAM-NESTED-AUTH. Before S443 its auth= was dropped the same way: an anonymous GET of the page served it at 200.
rationale: §4.12.2 (S443): 'An `auth=` attribute on a nested `<program>` — any `<program>` with a `<program>` or `<page>` ancestor — SHALL be a compile error (`E-PROGRAM-NESTED-AUTH`)'. The fix the error names is `<page auth="required">`.
